meta.title: Personal hub
meta.description: Personal add-ons for DeepSeek Harness: remote control from a Telegram chat or from the phone-first Web Remote bridge (no port opened), a Git panel in the right sidebar that shows local changes with per-file diffs, the commit log, pull requests with their check and review status, and issues — plus AI-drafted pull requests, an automatic worktree for each new chat created from the latest remote branch, cleanup once a Session’s pull request is merged, and automatic archiving of chats nobody has touched for a while.
